publications.name: Long War - Codex Supplement Raven Guard

sharedRules.name: Flesh over Steel
sharedRules.description:
• A Raven Guard army must include more units with the Infantry type than the Vehicle or Walker type.
• Raven Guard Space Marine Captains may not purchase the Chapter Master upgrade.
• Your army must include at least 1 unit with the Infiltrate special rule.

sharedRules.name: The Tri-Fold Path of Shadow
sharedRules.description:
• Raven Guard units gain the Skirmisher special rule. Raven Guard units with the Bulky (X) special rule gain the Hammer of Wrath (x) special rule instead of the Skirmisher special rule. If they already have Hammer of Wrath (x), increase the value of X by 1 (this is included in raven Guard
specific units).

• Raven Guard Aircraft type units gain the benefit of Light Cover. If it is already benefiting from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.
• A Raven Guard army may field Incursors at Troops choices with the Support Squad special rule.

sharedRules.name: Shadow Master
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule may Set to Disappear instead of Setting to Overwatch. At the end of your opponent’s Charge Phase, a unit that has Set to disappear may be removed from the battlefield and placed in Reserve. The unit may be removed even if enemy units are within 3” of it. At the end of your next Movement Phase, you may place the unit anywhere on the Battlefield more than 9” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Echo of the Ravenspire
rules.description: Once per game during the Movement Phase, instead of conducting a normal Movement, you may remove this model from the board. Place the Warlord back on the board anywhere on the Battlefield more than 9” away from any enemy models.

rules.name: Forward Planning
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this Warlord Trait, you may select a single Raven Guard unit in your army. That unit gains the Infiltrate special rule.

rules.name: Master of Shadows
rules.description: Once per game, at the start of the Battle Round, you may declare that Night Fighting is in effect. Night Fighting lasts until the start of the next Battle Round. You do not select Dawn or Dusk. Night Fighting is simply in effect this Round.

rules.name: Shard of Istvaan
rules.description: A model with this wargear may re-roll all hit rolls against units with the Chaos Space Marines Keyword.

rules.name: Shadow Masters Cloak
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains a 4+ Cover save while benefiting from Light Cover.

rules.name: Infravisor
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Night Vision special rule.

rules.name: Corvia
rules.description: A model with this wargear may re-roll Cover Save rolls.

rules.name: Raven’s Fury
rules.description: Only models eligible to buy a Jump Pack my purchase this Relic. A model equipped with this Relic gains +2 to its Strength (S) characteristic for the purposes of resolving Hammer of Wrath (x) Attacks. In addition, they gain the benefits of a Jump Pack.

rules.name: The Armor of Shadows
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains 2+ Armor Save. In addition, they can only be targeted by Shooting Attacks in your opponent’s Shooting Phase if they are the closest visible enemy unit.

rules.name: The Raven Skull of Korvaad
rules.description: A model with this Relic gains +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic. If a model equipped with this Relic is still alive and on the battlefield at the end of the game, score 1 additional Victory Point. If the model equipped with this Relic is slain and removed from play, place an Objective Point Marker within 3” of them before removing the model from play. The Objective Marker is now worth 1 Victory Point.

rules.name: Blackwing Mantle
rules.description: The Blackwing Mantle is a Jump Pack. It confers all the benefits of a Jump Pack. However, the unit’s Movement (M) characteristic is increased to 18” instead.

rules.name: Master of the Tri-Fold Path
rules.description: if this model is your Warlord, it and any attached unit gain the infiltrate and Outflank special rules. In addition, the warlord and any attached unit may re-roll failed Charge Rolls in the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Master of Ambush
rules.description: if this unit is your Warlord, you may select up to 2 friendly Raven Guard units to gain the Outflank special rule. Add +1 to the result when rolling to determine if a unit will arrive via Outflank.

rules.name: The Raven Helm
rules.description: A model with this wargear has the Fear (3) special rule.

rules.name: Bloodied Hunter
rules.description: if this model is you Warlord, select a single enemy unit in your opponent’s army. This unit and any attached unit have +1 to Wound and Penetration Rolls against that unit.

rules.name: Initial Sabotage
rules.description: if this model is you Warlord, during deployment, before either side deploys units, placed 3+D3 explosive sabotage markers anywhere on the battlefield. The first time any unit ends their Movement Phase within 6” of one of these markers, they take D6 Strength 3, AP Automatic Hits.

rules.name: Presence Unheeded
rules.description: A unit with this ability may not join friendly units even though it has the Character special rule This unit cannot be targeted for an attack unless by enemy units in the Shooting Phase unless it is the closest visible enemy unit.

rules.name: Shadow Bird Pilot
rules.description: This unit may pivot 180 degrees at any point during its Movement instead of 90 degrees.

rules.name: Quantum Field Repeller’s
rules.description: When this unit uses the Hover special rule and enter Hover mode, its Movement (M) characteristic becomes 15” instead of 12”.

rules.name: Rad Shroud Armour
rules.description: This unit always gains the benefit of Light Cover. If it is already benefiting from Light Cover, it gains the benefit of Heavy Cover instead.
